package student

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"mime"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"strings"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	domainservice "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/service"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

const maximumResponseBytes = 1 << 20
const maximumPlanningReadinessResponseBytes = 16 << 10

const learnerOverviewVersion = "student-learner-overview-v2"

type Client struct {
	BaseURL    string
	ReadToken  string
	WriteToken string
	HTTPClient *http.Client
}

type planningReadinessSnapshotWire struct {
	Schema         string                          `json:"schema"`
	StudentID      string                          `json:"student_id"`
	StateRef       domain.StudentReadinessStateRef `json:"state_ref"`
	LearningIntent json.RawMessage                 `json:"learning_intent"`
	Profile        planningReadinessProfileWire    `json:"profile"`
	ActivePath     json.RawMessage                 `json:"active_path"`
}

type planningReadinessProfileWire struct {
	DirectionCode          json.RawMessage             `json:"direction_code"`
	SelfAssessedExperience json.RawMessage             `json:"self_assessed_experience"`
	KnownStacks            planningReadinessStacksWire `json:"known_stacks"`
	DesiredStacks          planningReadinessStacksWire `json:"desired_stacks"`
	PreferredLanguage      json.RawMessage             `json:"preferred_language"`
	ContentLanguage        json.RawMessage             `json:"content_language"`
	WeeklyMinutes          json.RawMessage             `json:"weekly_minutes"`
	PreferredPace          json.RawMessage             `json:"preferred_pace"`
}

type planningReadinessStacksWire struct {
	State  string          `json:"state"`
	Values json.RawMessage `json:"values"`
}

func (client Client) GetPlanningReadiness(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot, error) {
	if !isCanonicalUUID(studentID) {
		return domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	requestURL := strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/") + "/internal/students/" +
		url.PathEscape(studentID) + "/planning-readiness"
	var wire planningReadinessSnapshotWire
	if err := client.doStrictReadinessGET(ctx, requestURL, &wire); err != nil {
		return domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{}, err
	}
	snapshot, err := readinessSnapshotFromWire(wire)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{}, err
	}
	snapshot, err = domain.NormalizeStudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot(snapshot)
	if err != nil || snapshot.StudentID != studentID {
		return domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return snapshot, nil
}

func readinessSnapshotFromWire(wire planningReadinessSnapshotWire) (domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot, error) {
	direction, err := decodeOptionalReadiness[string](wire.Profile.DirectionCode)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{}, err
	}
	experience, err := decodeOptionalReadiness[string](wire.Profile.SelfAssessedExperience)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{}, err
	}
	intent, err := decodeOptionalReadiness[domain.StudentReadinessLearningIntent](wire.LearningIntent)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{}, err
	}
	preferredLanguage, err := decodeOptionalReadiness[domain.StudentReadinessLanguage](wire.Profile.PreferredLanguage)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{}, err
	}
	contentLanguage, err := decodeOptionalReadiness[domain.StudentReadinessLanguage](wire.Profile.ContentLanguage)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{}, err
	}
	weeklyMinutes, err := decodeOptionalReadiness[int](wire.Profile.WeeklyMinutes)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{}, err
	}
	preferredPace, err := decodeOptionalReadiness[string](wire.Profile.PreferredPace)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{}, err
	}
	activePath, err := decodeOptionalReadiness[domain.StudentReadinessActivePath](wire.ActivePath)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{}, err
	}
	known, err := readinessStacksFromWire(wire.Profile.KnownStacks)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{}, err
	}
	desired, err := readinessStacksFromWire(wire.Profile.DesiredStacks)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{}, err
	}
	snapshot := domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{
		Schema: wire.Schema, StudentID: wire.StudentID, StateRef: wire.StateRef,
		LearningIntent: intent, ActivePath: activePath,
		Profile: domain.StudentReadinessProfile{
			KnownStacks: known, DesiredStacks: desired,
			PreferredLanguage: preferredLanguage, ContentLanguage: contentLanguage,
			WeeklyMinutes: weeklyMinutes, PreferredPace: preferredPace,
		},
	}
	if direction != nil {
		snapshot.Profile.DirectionCode = *direction
	}
	if experience != nil {
		snapshot.Profile.SelfAssessedExperience = *experience
	}
	return snapshot, nil
}

func readinessStacksFromWire(wire planningReadinessStacksWire) (domain.StudentReadinessStackValues, error) {
	result := domain.StudentReadinessStackValues{State: wire.State, ValuesPresent: wire.Values != nil}
	if wire.Values != nil {
		if err := decodeStrictReadinessJSON(wire.Values, &result.Values); err != nil || result.Values == nil {
			return domain.StudentReadinessStackValues{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
	}
	return result, nil
}

func decodeOptionalReadiness[T any](raw json.RawMessage) (*T, error) {
	if raw == nil {
		return nil, nil
	}
	var result T
	if err := decodeStrictReadinessJSON(raw, &result); err != nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return &result, nil
}

func decodeStrictReadinessJSON(raw []byte, target any) error {
	if string(bytes.TrimSpace(raw)) == "null" {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}

func (client Client) doStrictReadinessGET(ctx context.Context, requestURL string, response any) error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(client.BaseURL) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(client.ReadToken) == "" || client.HTTPClient == nil {
		return errors.New("student client is not configured")
	}
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, requestURL, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", client.ReadToken)
	request.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
	httpResponse, err := client.HTTPClient.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() { _ = httpResponse.Body.Close() }()
	contents, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(httpResponse.Body, maximumPlanningReadinessResponseBytes+1))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if len(contents) > maximumPlanningReadinessResponseBytes {
		return errors.New("student planning readiness response exceeds limit")
	}
	if httpResponse.StatusCode < 200 || httpResponse.StatusCode >= 300 {
		switch httpResponse.StatusCode {
		case http.StatusNotFound:
			return domain.ErrNotFound
		case http.StatusConflict:
			return domain.ErrConflict
		case http.StatusBadRequest, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity:
			return domain.ErrValidation
		default:
			return fmt.Errorf("student returned status %d", httpResponse.StatusCode)
		}
	}
	if err := decodeStrictReadinessJSON(contents, response); err != nil {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}

func (client Client) GetPlanningProfile(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.StudentPlanningProfile, error) {
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(studentID); err != nil {
		return domain.StudentPlanningProfile{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	var response struct {
		StudentID  string `json:"student_id"`
		Version    string `json:"version"`
		Onboarding *struct {
			Version                int64    `json:"version"`
			DirectionCode          string   `json:"direction_code"`
			SelfAssessedExperience string   `json:"self_assessed_experience"`
			KnownStacks            []string `json:"known_stacks"`
			DesiredStacks          []string `json:"desired_stacks"`
			GoalCode               string   `json:"goal_code"`
			PreferredLanguage      string   `json:"preferred_language"`
			WeeklyMinutes          int      `json:"weekly_minutes"`
			PreferredPace          string   `json:"preferred_pace"`
			ProfileVersion         string   `json:"profile_version"`
		} `json:"onboarding"`
		LearningPath *struct {
			CourseID          string `json:"course_id"`
			GoalCode          string `json:"goal_code"`
			CourseFingerprint string `json:"course_fingerprint"`
			Version           int64  `json:"version"`
		} `json:"learning_path"`
	}
	requestURL := strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/") + "/internal/students/" + url.PathEscape(studentID) + "/learner-overview"
	if err := client.doJSON(ctx, http.MethodGet, requestURL, client.ReadToken, "", nil, &response); err != nil {
		return domain.StudentPlanningProfile{}, err
	}
	if response.StudentID != studentID || response.Version != learnerOverviewVersion {
		return domain.StudentPlanningProfile{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if response.Onboarding == nil {
		return domain.StudentPlanningProfile{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	if response.Onboarding.Version < 1 {
		return domain.StudentPlanningProfile{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	profile, err := domain.NormalizeStudentPlanningProfile(domain.StudentPlanningProfile{
		DirectionCode:          response.Onboarding.DirectionCode,
		SelfAssessedExperience: response.Onboarding.SelfAssessedExperience,
		KnownStacks:            response.Onboarding.KnownStacks, DesiredStacks: response.Onboarding.DesiredStacks,
		GoalCode: response.Onboarding.GoalCode, PreferredLanguage: response.Onboarding.PreferredLanguage,
		WeeklyMinutes: response.Onboarding.WeeklyMinutes, PreferredPace: response.Onboarding.PreferredPace,
		ProfileVersion:    response.Onboarding.ProfileVersion,
		OnboardingVersion: response.Onboarding.Version,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentPlanningProfile{}, err
	}
	if response.LearningPath != nil {
		if response.LearningPath.Version < 1 {
			return domain.StudentPlanningProfile{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		profile.LearningPathVersion = response.LearningPath.Version
		profile.LearningPathCourseID = strings.TrimSpace(response.LearningPath.CourseID)
		profile.LearningPathGoalCode = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(response.LearningPath.GoalCode))
		profile.LearningPathRevision = strings.TrimSpace(response.LearningPath.CourseFingerprint)
	}
	return profile, nil
}

func (client Client) QueryMastery(
	ctx context.Context,
	studentID string,
	targets []domain.TargetRef,
) ([]domain.TargetMastery, error) {
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(studentID); err != nil || len(targets) == 0 || len(targets) > 100 {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	var response struct {
		Items []domain.TargetMastery `json:"items"`
	}
	requestURL := strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/") + "/internal/students/" + url.PathEscape(studentID) + "/mastery/query"
	if err := client.doJSON(ctx, http.MethodPost, requestURL, client.ReadToken, "", map[string]any{"targets": targets}, &response); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if len(response.Items) != len(targets) {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return response.Items, nil
}

func (client Client) AssignCourse(
	ctx context.Context,
	studentID string,
	courseID string,
	planningRequestID string,
	idempotencyKey string,
) error {
	if _, studentErr := uuid.Parse(studentID); studentErr != nil {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if _, courseErr := uuid.Parse(courseID); courseErr != nil {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if _, requestErr := uuid.Parse(planningRequestID); requestErr != nil {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if _, keyErr := uuid.Parse(idempotencyKey); keyErr != nil {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	requestURL := strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/") + "/internal/students/" +
		url.PathEscape(studentID) + "/courses/" + url.PathEscape(courseID) + "/assignment"
	return client.doJSON(ctx, http.MethodPut, requestURL, client.WriteToken, idempotencyKey, map[string]any{
		"planning_request_id": planningRequestID,
		"assigned_by":         "learning_planner",
	}, nil)
}

func (client Client) CreateLearningPath(
	ctx context.Context,
	studentID string,
	idempotencyKey string,
	replacement domain.LearningPathReplacement,
) (domain.LearningPathAllocation, error) {
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(studentID); err != nil || replacement.ExpectedVersion != 0 || len(replacement.Items) == 0 {
		return domain.LearningPathAllocation{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(idempotencyKey); err != nil {
		return domain.LearningPathAllocation{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(replacement.PlanningRequestID); err != nil {
		return domain.LearningPathAllocation{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	requestURL := strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/") + "/internal/students/" +
		url.PathEscape(studentID) + "/learning-path"
	var response struct {
		ID                string `json:"id"`
		StudentID         string `json:"student_id"`
		CourseID          string `json:"course_id"`
		GoalCode          string `json:"goal_code"`
		CourseFingerprint string `json:"course_fingerprint"`
		Version           int64  `json:"version"`
	}
	if err := client.doJSON(ctx, http.MethodPut, requestURL, client.WriteToken, idempotencyKey, replacement, &response); err != nil {
		return domain.LearningPathAllocation{}, err
	}
	allocation, err := domain.NormalizeLearningPathAllocation(domain.LearningPathAllocation{
		LearningPathID: response.ID, StudentID: response.StudentID, CourseID: response.CourseID,
		GoalCode: response.GoalCode, CourseFingerprint: response.CourseFingerprint, PathVersion: response.Version,
	})
	if err != nil || allocation.StudentID != studentID || allocation.CourseID != replacement.CourseID ||
		allocation.GoalCode != strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(replacement.GoalCode)) ||
		allocation.CourseFingerprint != strings.TrimSpace(replacement.CourseFingerprint) {
		return domain.LearningPathAllocation{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return allocation, nil
}

func (client Client) GetLearningPathPlanningState(
	ctx context.Context,
	studentID string,
	learningPathID string,
) (domain.LearningPathPlanningState, error) {
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(studentID); err != nil {
		return domain.LearningPathPlanningState{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(learningPathID); err != nil {
		return domain.LearningPathPlanningState{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	requestURL := strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/") + "/internal/students/" +
		url.PathEscape(studentID) + "/learning-paths/" + url.PathEscape(learningPathID) + "/planning-state"
	var state domain.LearningPathPlanningState
	if err := client.doJSON(ctx, http.MethodGet, requestURL, client.WriteToken, "", nil, &state); err != nil {
		return domain.LearningPathPlanningState{}, err
	}
	state, err := domain.NormalizeLearningPathPlanningState(state)
	if err != nil || state.StudentID != studentID || state.LearningPathID != learningPathID {
		return domain.LearningPathPlanningState{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return state, nil
}

func (client Client) ReplanLearningPath(
	ctx context.Context,
	studentID string,
	idempotencyKey string,
	replan domain.LearningPathReplan,
) (domain.LearningPathCommandResult, error) {
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(studentID); err != nil {
		return domain.LearningPathCommandResult{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	replan, err := domain.NormalizeLearningPathReplan(replan)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearningPathCommandResult{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(idempotencyKey); err != nil {
		return domain.LearningPathCommandResult{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(replan.PlanningRequestID); err != nil {
		return domain.LearningPathCommandResult{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	requestURL := strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/") + "/internal/students/" +
		url.PathEscape(studentID) + "/learning-paths/" + url.PathEscape(replanPathID(replan))
	return client.applyLearningPathCommand(ctx, requestURL, idempotencyKey, replan.PlanningRequestID, "REPLAN", studentID, replanPathID(replan), replan)
}

func (client Client) CompleteLearningPath(
	ctx context.Context,
	studentID string,
	idempotencyKey string,
	completion domain.LearningPathCompletion,
) (domain.LearningPathCommandResult, error) {
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(studentID); err != nil {
		return domain.LearningPathCommandResult{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	completion, err := domain.NormalizeLearningPathCompletion(completion)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearningPathCommandResult{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(idempotencyKey); err != nil {
		return domain.LearningPathCommandResult{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(completion.PlanningRequestID); err != nil {
		return domain.LearningPathCommandResult{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	pathID := strings.TrimSpace(completion.LearningPathID)
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(pathID); err != nil {
		return domain.LearningPathCommandResult{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	requestURL := strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/") + "/internal/students/" +
		url.PathEscape(studentID) + "/learning-paths/" + url.PathEscape(pathID) + "/completion"
	return client.applyLearningPathCommand(ctx, requestURL, idempotencyKey, completion.PlanningRequestID, "NO_GAP", studentID, pathID, completion)
}

// ReserveDiagnosticAssessment delivers Planner's immutable fixed plan to the
// Student-owned placement boundary. It is replay-safe on plan.ID only.
func (client Client) ReserveDiagnosticAssessment(ctx context.Context, studentID string, plan domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentReservation, error) {
	if domain.ValidateDiagnosticPlan(plan) != nil || studentID != plan.StudentID {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentReservation{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	requestURL := strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/") + "/internal/v1/students/" + url.PathEscape(studentID) + "/diagnostic-assessments/" + url.PathEscape(plan.ID) + "/reserve"
	var receipt domain.DiagnosticAssessmentReservation
	if err := client.doDiagnosticJSON(ctx, http.MethodPost, requestURL, plan.ID, plan, &receipt); err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentReservation{}, err
	}
	if err := domain.ValidateDiagnosticReservation(receipt, plan); err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentReservation{}, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	return receipt, nil
}

func (client Client) GetDiagnosticAssessmentResult(ctx context.Context, studentID string, attemptID string) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentResult, error) {
	if !isCanonicalUUID(studentID) || !isCanonicalUUID(attemptID) {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentResult{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	requestURL := strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/") + "/internal/v1/students/" + url.PathEscape(studentID) + "/diagnostic-assessments/" + url.PathEscape(attemptID) + "/result"
	var result domain.DiagnosticAssessmentResult
	if err := client.doDiagnosticJSON(ctx, http.MethodGet, requestURL, "", nil, &result); err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentResult{}, err
	}
	return result, nil
}

func replanPathID(replan domain.LearningPathReplan) string {
	return strings.TrimSpace(replan.LearningPathID)
}

func (client Client) applyLearningPathCommand(
	ctx context.Context,
	requestURL string,
	idempotencyKey string,
	planningRequestID string,
	command string,
	studentID string,
	learningPathID string,
	payload any,
) (domain.LearningPathCommandResult, error) {
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(learningPathID); err != nil {
		return domain.LearningPathCommandResult{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	var result domain.LearningPathCommandResult
	if err := client.doJSON(ctx, http.MethodPut, requestURL, client.WriteToken, idempotencyKey, payload, &result); err != nil {
		return domain.LearningPathCommandResult{}, err
	}
	result, err := domain.NormalizeLearningPathCommandResult(result)
	if err != nil || result.PlanningRequestID != planningRequestID || result.Command != command ||
		result.State.StudentID != studentID || result.State.LearningPathID != learningPathID {
		return domain.LearningPathCommandResult{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (client Client) doJSON(
	ctx context.Context,
	method string,
	requestURL string,
	token string,
	idempotencyKey string,
	payload any,
	response any,
) error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(client.BaseURL) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(token) == "" || client.HTTPClient == nil {
		return errors.New("student client is not configured")
	}
	var body io.Reader
	if payload != nil {
		encoded, err := json.Marshal(payload)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		body = bytes.NewReader(encoded)
	}
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, method, requestURL, body)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", token)
	request.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
	if payload != nil {
		request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	}
	if idempotencyKey != "" {
		request.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", idempotencyKey)
	}
	httpResponse, err := client.HTTPClient.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() { _ = httpResponse.Body.Close() }()
	limited := io.LimitReader(httpResponse.Body, maximumResponseBytes+1)
	contents, err := io.ReadAll(limited)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if len(contents) > maximumResponseBytes {
		return errors.New("student response exceeds limit")
	}
	if httpResponse.StatusCode < 200 || httpResponse.StatusCode >= 300 {
		switch httpResponse.StatusCode {
		case http.StatusNotFound:
			return domain.ErrNotFound
		case http.StatusConflict:
			if strings.TrimSpace(string(contents)) == "diagnostic_context_stale" {
				return domain.ErrDiagnosticContextStale
			}
			return domain.ErrConflict
		case http.StatusBadRequest, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity:
			return domain.ErrValidation
		default:
			return fmt.Errorf("student returned status %d", httpResponse.StatusCode)
		}
	}
	if response == nil {
		return nil
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(contents))
	if err := decoder.Decode(response); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

func (client Client) doDiagnosticJSON(ctx context.Context, method, requestURL, idempotencyKey string, payload any, response any) error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(client.BaseURL) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(client.WriteToken) == "" || client.HTTPClient == nil {
		return errors.New("student diagnostic client is not configured")
	}
	var body io.Reader
	if payload != nil {
		encoded, err := json.Marshal(payload)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		body = bytes.NewReader(encoded)
	}
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, method, requestURL, body)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", client.WriteToken)
	req.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
	if payload != nil {
		req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	}
	if idempotencyKey != "" {
		req.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", idempotencyKey)
	}
	noRedirect := *client.HTTPClient
	noRedirect.CheckRedirect = func(*http.Request, []*http.Request) error { return http.ErrUseLastResponse }
	res, err := noRedirect.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() { _ = res.Body.Close() }()
	contents, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(res.Body, maximumResponseBytes+1))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if len(contents) > maximumResponseBytes {
		return domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	if res.StatusCode == http.StatusNotFound {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	if res.StatusCode >= 500 {
		return domain.ErrUpstreamUnavailable
	}
	if res.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	media, _, err := mime.ParseMediaType(res.Header.Get("Content-Type"))
	if err != nil || media != "application/json" {
		return domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(contents))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(response); err != nil {
		return domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	if decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}) != io.EOF {
		return domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	return nil
}

func isCanonicalUUID(raw string) bool {
	value, err := uuid.Parse(raw)
	return err == nil && value.String() == raw
}

var _ domainservice.StudentService = Client{}
var _ domainservice.StudentPlanningReadinessService = Client{}
var _ domainservice.DiagnosticAssessmentStudentService = Client{}
